description: Looks up a sebbi fact: a record anyone can prove for themselves against Bitcoin. Give any sebbi.pro record code (SC-, RD-, IR-, ER-, WA-, DR-, OK-, IC-, NT-, HK-), a chain block number or a SHA-256 fingerprint. Returns the plain-English statement, what is proven, whether it is in Bitcoin yet, the fact page link to cite, and the proof file. If nothing matches, it says no proven fact exists. Read-only.

include_proof.description: Include the full proof file (default false)

ref.description: Record code, chain block number or SHA-256 fingerprint

name: sebbi_fact
title: Look up a sebbi fact
